items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Except there's one time I was on the road with Jerry Gray... He made us go on the road; he held the job over our head

ctx.x: I don't feel good... You'd never think I was an athlete, would you? I was a slam-bang tennis player, volleyball, roofball(?), everything, swimming... I used to swim across lakes and everything. Did the Australian Crawl without stopping, all the way across. Spirit Lake, that's one big lake. You could take a boat, you know, have a guy row.
